 Home › News News News GTA 6 Fever: UK Schools offer students up to Rs 8,600 in gift vouchers to stop them from skipping classes The excitement around the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) on November 19, 2026 has spread to classrooms in the United Kingdom. Students are looking forward to the game with anticipation and might skip schools the next day. The timing is very important here because the game release happens on the day of GCSE Mathematics exams for year 11 and some year 12 students. Therefore, UK schools are offering students gift vouchers worth up to Rs 8,600 to prevent absences during the GTA 6 launch.
 School holiday tomorrow, 20 November: Are schools closed on Friday? Check state-wise updates Schools are likely to stay open on Friday, November 20, 2026, in most states. No nationwide holiday has been announced. Local closures are still possible due to festivities and air pollution, so parents should check their school’s notice before getting children ready for school...
 CLAT 2027 admit card expected soon, check steps to download hall ticket The Consortium will conduct the entrance test on December 6, 2026, from 2 pm to 4 pm in offline mode
 CISCE launches SHINE 2026 assessment for Classes 4, 6 and 9: What students will be tested on and how it differs from regular exams CISCE has launched SHINE 2026, a free and mandatory digital assessment for students of Classes 4, 6 and 9 across affiliated schools. Nearly 450 schools began testing within 48 hours of its launch. The assessment covers English, Mathematics, Science and socio-emotional competencies, helping teachers identify learning gaps and improve students' academic development.
 Karnataka 1st PUC Time Table 2027 Released: Class 11 Exams to begin on February 10, Check subject wise schedule The Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board (KSEAB) has released the timetable for the Karnataka 1st PUC Annual Examination 2027. Students in Class 11 across the state can now check their -wise exam dates on the official website. The timetable is important for students in the Science, Commerce and Arts streams as it lists the dates for language papers and core subjects.This year there is an update in the exam system.
 Bihar government jobs 2026: 5,000 vacancies for Amin, Kanungo and Clerk posts expected; notification and application details to follow Bihar Revenue Department Recruitment 2026: Around 5,000 vacancies are expected for Amin, Kanungo and Clerk posts. Check first-phase vacancies, notification date and recruitment details.
 Following SC order, UGC urges students to verify universities’ legal status before admission Students and parents have been advised to confirm whether an institution is legally established or recognised under applicable laws, and whether it holds the authority to offer the specific programme and award the corresponding degree or qualification under the UGC Act, 1956
 Karnataka plans model startup parks on 1,000 acres near Bengaluru and 100-200 acres near Hubballi-Dharwad: what M B Patil announced at BTS 2026 The Karnataka government has announced plans to set up model startup parks near Bengaluru and Hubballi-Dharwad, as it tries to give young companies access to affordable land and strengthen the state's startup ecosystem. Large and Medium Industries Minister M B Patil said on Wednesday that the parks would cover 1,000 acres near Bengaluru and 100-200 acres near Hubballi-Dharwad. The announcement was made at the Bengaluru Tech Summit (BTS) 2026.
